Applehead.desc: Apple you glad I didn't say banana?

abilities: Increases damage by 999% while you have a meal buff active. /j (does nothing)

Harrowing Marrow.desc: A frightening mask made from the bones of the wicked.
abilities: When bleeding procs near you, gain a buff to regen and defense, and enter bloodthirst immediately.

Carnival Cap.desc: An awesome cap that absolutely rocks

Indicator.desc: Anyone who crosses you is surely dead meat.
abilities: Rolling restores ammo. Weapons above 35% heat will inflict fire on hit.
[Skill] Summon a trusty Eangran pal to your side, who can bite and breathe fire.
[Skill] Shoot lots of arrows into the sky.
[Skill] Throw out a barrage of blue firecrackers that explode when hit.
Azure Firecrackers.Notes: Description claims 20 mana, but this is false.

abilities: Adapts your Rusty Bell to be used in the ways of the False Believer. Third swing and rolls after successful hits release bell orbs that track onto enemies.
[Skill] Launch an incendiary bomb that can be aimed. If used midair, spin away in the direction you're moving.
[Skill] Throw a daggers.
[Skill] Infuse your weapon with darkness or spin for 20 seconds. Has unique interactions with certain weapons.
Darkspin Arts.Notes: Has special interaction with the Blizzard Greataxe.

abilities: Charge up a quickdraw.
[Skill] Perform a special counter. If used after rolling, do an ankle cutting sweep that grants a buff on hit.
Blocking has special effects when blocking with a shield equipped.
You recover immediately from a guard break every 10 seconds.
Your swings are 20% slower.
[Skill] Rally enemies to you, and enter a brief unbreakable state where your parries also act as blocks.
[Skill] Deliver a strong uppercut that launches you in the air. Can be followed up with a devastating, spinning slam.
[Skill] Spin forth in the direction you're facing. Has dodge frames.
[Skill] Draw a magic circle of chalk in the ground that regenerates 10% of your max mana for every second that you stand in it.
[Skill] Perform a flurry of swipes that has 50% increased crit chance and 100% increased bloodthirst buildup. Can be performed repeatedly if you have enough mana.
[Skill] Infuse your weapon with blood or chaos for 20 seconds. Has unique interactions with certain weapons.
[Skill] Fire a burst of sticky nails that will inflict Slimed. Nails that hit enemies have a chance to Corrode them.
Your fighting style with spears now uses sharp, powerful lunges. Your first two swing inflict Bleeding, and your last inflicts stacking Venom.
[Skill] Air gun now shoots a concentrated bolt of lightning that explodes on impact. Loading air powder increases efficiency. Increases startup by 2.5x and mana cost by 1.5x.
[Skill] Dash forward at the speed of sound. Reflects off walls.
[Skill] Roll back and shoot a wide spread of arrows forward.
[Skill] Uppercut with your anchor, sending out 3 waves. Can be used twice in quick succession when you have Sailor Rage.
[Skill] Enter a twisted stance to counter incoming attacks. Successful counters charge up your weapon, and amplify the next attack.
[Skill] Stomp the ground, unearthing a boulder to pelt at your opponents.

[Skill] Consume amber stacks to conjure a large shield of amber that heals and protects those standing in it. The shield is fragile and can only defend so many attacks. Deal magic damage to gain amber stacks.
[Skill] Stomp the ground, unearthing a colossal boulder that will come crashing right down again.
[Skill] Do a descending kick that inflicts Decay. When damage is dealt to a decayed enemy, they will take additional true damage.
[Skill] Hit em' with a sick dropkick. They'll never see it coming!

Bronze Greatsword.desc: A big and heavy bronze blade.

Magic Branch.desc: An enchanted branch that can cast spells!

Bosca.desc: Renowned for its brilliant box-like shape. Fires a burst of 3 bullets.

Crude Club.desc: Though crude and heavy, it will stun your enemies.

Cutlass.desc: A sharp cutlass dropped by a pirate.

Demetal Greatbow.desc: The demetal reacts strongly to arrowheads.

Iron Battleaxe.desc: Efficient at cleaving through hordes of enemies.

Iron Greatsword.desc: This big and heavy iron sword can crush.

Iron Sword.desc: You can't go wrong with a trusty iron sword.

Sand Wand.desc: A bejeweled wand. Produces scorching sand that temporarily lowers enemy defense.

Shotel.desc: A sleek curved blade that can tear through defense..

Triplex Bow.desc: A dusty and quirky old bow pilfered from a raider.

Vuvuzela.desc: Summon Mini Thieves to fight for you.

Crossbow.desc: A sturdy crossbow. Charges nigh instantly but with a longer cooldown.

Demetal Maul.desc: Smash and slam with pyres of flame.

Demetal Sword.desc: A fiery blade forged from flames.

Eye Vuvuzela.desc: Summon Eyes to fight for you.

Icedagger.desc: Summons icicles above foes struck with a critical hit. Cold as ice!

Icicle Rod.desc: Raise up icicles towards your cursor that inflict frostburn.

Magma Shackles.desc: Feel bad for whoever had to wear these during sentencing.

Magma Shotgun.desc: How did that hit for 35!? Bullets have a chance to inflict fire.

Mithril Spear.desc: Spike it like a spike of cold ice.

Musket.desc: A popular fiream on the battlefield. Comes with a free bayonet!

Phoenix Staff.desc: Shoots three fireballs in an arc.

Air Gun.desc: Pops out a burst of pellets.

Blunderbuss.desc: A classic pirate gun. Powerful up close, but very weak at range

Clever Tome.desc: Grants a buff to you. Use the Heavy attack to buff teammates.

Executioner's Greatsword.desc: Break a neck or two. Deals 25% more damage to enemies under half health.

Gilded Greatsword.desc: This golden sword may shock your foes...

Mana Blade.desc: Utilises mana to increase damage, but performs terribly without it.

Pitch Dagger.desc: Thread the needle just like this.

Rockwondo.desc: An old style of fighting that punches and bruises.

Sandpod Spear.desc: Why does a Sandpod have this?

Scrap Longsword.desc: A broken down blade that makes good use of bleeding.

Scrap Sickle.desc: Crude and cruel, this deadly tool cuts deep into your foes.

Silver Axe.desc: Keeps the vampires from your door.

Silver Rapier.desc: A duelist's go-to weapon. The tip is exceptionally sharp...

Squid Blaster.desc: Blast and spray ink. Or oil rather. Heavy attack revs the engine.

Sundowners.desc: Revolvers once held by the Shock Marauder. Wonder why he needed two?

Zap Antenna.desc: Summons a bolt of lightning upon your cursor. Just don't hit yourself.

Acrid Longbow.desc: Made from the limb of a vile creature.

Blizzard Greataxe.desc: A harbinger of winter, crafted by the elements themselves. Heavy attack leaves behind icicles.

Blizzard Greatbow.desc: Splintered from a snowman. Ice arrows shot are turned into giant icicles.

Brain Brawl.desc: The best of both brains and brawn.

Cannon.desc: A heavy and sluggish, yet very deadly cannon.

Champion's Bow.desc: An ornate bow from a past long forgotten...

Crabhand.desc: Combo a backflip into a grab heavy attack!

Creepy Claw.desc: This creepy claw may inflict venom on your foes...

Crystalspine.desc: Tropical and aquatic. Here come the crystals...

Dual Bosca.desc: Twice the firepower... amongst other more useful modifications.

Empyrean Maul.desc: HEAVENS ABOVE, WHAT IS THAT MELODY?!?

Halberd.desc: Cleave, chop, stab; these are the riches of the poor.

Haunted Scythe.desc: Forged from death, it stirs with life.

Megaton Maul.desc: This maul is so mighty and heavy you wouldn't trust it with lunch!

Nagakiba.desc: An elegant sword with a comically long, though extra sharp blade.

Prime Brand.desc: Shoots lasers that do more damage the more full your health is.

Prime Scepter.desc: Shoots extra orbs above 75% health. Extra orbs deal 10% of the original orb's damage.

Scarebow.desc: Thrown together with wicked bits and bobs. Scrap arrows shot will inflict scared.

Smart Stem Staff.desc: Summon a Brain Buddie that buffs you and debuffs enemies.

Trident.desc: A long spear dropped by a fish mongler.

Vine Wand.desc: Casts vines that dig through the ground and repeatedly cut enemies.

Azure Pinwheel.desc: A special design by the Windman, able to circle wind through its blades to bear blue flames.

Azure Rocket.desc: A grand old weapon of war. Charged explosive arrows shot are converted into blue firecrackers.

Berried Cleaver.desc: Blunted and carved by sickly sweetness. Throw to burst berries. Bursting berries resets your heavy cooldown.

Bigfish Gauntlet.desc: A special gauntlet that takes after the likes of the Bigfish... Zappy!

Bloodtwin.desc: Detached and mangled. A quivering spine of gore.

Buster Sword.desc: A blade so heavy, and so metal.

Catatome.desc: Filled with all kinds of devious magics.

Ceremonial Greatblade.desc: Bai's signature greatsword. Adorned with paper tags to show reverence for his homeland.

Champion's Gladius.desc: An ancient weapon of war made to pierce through armor.

Clerick Tome.desc: Filled with all kinds of devious magics.

Coffinhilt.desc: Decrepit in the crypts. Haunted by its former glory...

Coffinlock.desc: I didn't rig any of this. Lock and load souls from defeating enemies.

EGGMG.desc: A highly advanced, automatic firearm. Comes with a barrel that launches Egg Grenades.

Kaismith Hammer.desc: Devai's trusty hammer. Its silver mauled many until its flame tempered his soul

Lostmasks.desc: A smile is only 180 degrees away from a frown.

Maimed Cudgel.desc: Jagged and shoddy, yet very deadly if you hit the right spot.

Mephisosceles.desc: In a time before light. the shapeworld existed as an endless plane of wax. Now, it houses the fundamental shapes and symbols that permeate the visible world.

Nos Dywyll.desc: Jim; a vigilante who simply pillaged more rifts than we did? Or a Hunter handpicked by shadows? We may never know.

Noxious Mortar.desc: Shoots sticky bombs that explode with a heavy attack. Does more damage if midair or near expiry.

Prism Lance.desc: Unending. Beam of light. A tunnel. In my mind.

Prism Staff.desc: Shoots crystal prisms. Heavy attack obliterates everything, metaphorically.

Rusty Bell.desc: I should be rising in the sky.

Shroomerang.desc: All things must come to a dream.

Slime Hammer.desc: That's a lot of gum on your plate.

Snowshatters.desc: Elegant and fragile tools used in dance.

Sporeshot.desc: Our flow and pull of life itself.

Sunyata.desc: You were there all along. The guiding light will scare your troubles miles away. Critical hits build up guidance that can be spent to summon beams of light

Tektite Arc.desc: An absurdly obsidian and alien mechanism. Charge it up with explosive power.

Tektite Ballista.desc: Some sort of bizarre launcher with scorching blast power.

Tektite Crusher.desc: The bane of rock and restless dune beasts.

Twigclaws.desc: Overgrown claws of a twigface. Heavy attack bursts berries.

Twisted Cage.desc: Tempered by brutal blasts of white hot flame, this charred and warped cage.

Wicked Limb.desc: It's vile and gruesome and filled with dark energy.

Avenger Axe.desc: A truly cruel cleaver. An oversized serrated knife.

Cool Wrench.desc: I bet this thing could open a few vaults. Huh? I said nothing.

Daedalus Shot.desc: A sleek metal bow, packed with plasma energy and fitter with a... drill for close range combat?

Dreamdust Flask.desc: Massive flask of so-called "Dreamdust"; a powdery byproduct of temporal meddling and a dream manifested.

Gemini Blade.desc: A mechanical marvel of a weapon. It can switch between two forms, charge and unleash plasma, and probably cook hotdogs, too.

Graphite Lance.desc: I've never seen a blade so sharp.

Ithaca.desc: An eccentric weapon that is half gun, half blade. How innovative!

Malachite Buster.desc: An elegant yet fearsome battleaxe made of brass and malachite. Poison seeps from the blade.

Metacrab Termina.desc: Dual termina of a Metacrab that can conduct metal magic. Very pointy, very sharp.

Mor Teslabow.desc: Well, this is a bit uncanny. A bit unwieldy too.

Oxide Longsword.desc: A rending blade made from tough hide. Split the earth with great force.

Peluche.desc: Boom boom! Last round in the chamber shoots shotgun pellets.

Seer Smartgun.desc: A smart gun is always useful (citation needed) .

Stormcutter.desc: A piercing dagger imbued with a powerful storm.

Stormwaker.desc: Enchanted glaive that weaves storms. That's sick!

Teddy.desc: The signature weapon of the bear workshop. Fully automatic and deadly.

Womp Womp.desc: What a shame... With music, and silence.

Arcane Musket.desc: A rifle infused with arcane magic.

Black Ice.desc: An edgy, barbaric rifle. Swaps between bursts of ice and sprays of poisonous darts.

Deep Sea Tome.desc: A heavy, duty tome, filled with incantations from the deep.

Don Pampura.desc: A hulking beast of a weapon, fashioned in the shape of a giant shrimp. True strength is required to wield it.

Eventide.desc: Must sunset fall on all things? Special attacks are replicated while Doppelganger is active.

Green Gloves.desc: I'd hate the strain and the pain all over again...

Guiding Diamond.desc: We was there all along. Consumes mana to send out waves of light.

Laser Rapier.desc: It's over. You have the high ground.

Millennium Cannon.desc: Obliterating beams, blasts of red hot plasma - it's all right here in one handy cannon.

Owl Lyre.desc: Looks like a harp. The owls are not what they seem.

Owl Thorn.desc: Elusive birdman sword, steeped in dark turbulence.

Rib Snapper.desc: With its snapping jaw, it can send sonic blasts that fracture bones and beans alike.

Shredder.desc: Here's a futuristic guitar that sends out rending shockwaves of plasma. What about it?

Temple.desc: Wielding this legendary relic, the blade and the mind become one. Either that, or it's placebo.

The Big Cheese.desc: A gargantuan gun that can only be operated by mounting it on a table. Fires in one direction only. Requires 50 dexterity to operate.

Tinned Calamity.desc: Sealed stinging pain, like an onion to the eye. Unleashes a swarm of vicious leeches.

Umibozu.desc: Bubbles have a chance to inflict venom or poison buildup.

Wayfinder.desc: A magical gun imbued with the power of the stars. We'll be counting them.

The Jade Twin.desc: A priceless and mystical blade. Said to have been forged to protect a family of evil nobles.

Funky Driftlander.desc: A bizzare spear from another dimension. "I am from the Funky Drifting Land.", it whispers.

Ratboy Handgun.desc: A mechanical marvel engineered by the Ratboy people. Divine energy lies untapped within.

Red Powerfists.desc: Heavy metal fists imbued with powerful red energy. BING BONG!

Wicked Junk Spellbook.desc: A profaned tome containing corrupt, though powerful industrial spells

Decaying Eclipse.desc: This blade has only ever known decay. It brimmed with potential the last time it was sheathed, but that was years ago.
